name: lysine demethylase 5C

function.text: KDM5C encodes lysine-specific demethylase 5C demethylase 5C). Annotated molecular activities include histone demethylase activity and histone H3K4 demethylase activity. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to X-linked complex neurodevelopmental disorder (x-linked); intellectual developmental disorder, X-linked, syndromic, Claes-Jensen type (x-linked).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma; Lung Adenocarcinoma; Renal Cell Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
